Ugandan traffic law gives riders duties: Cik me yo pa Uganda miyo luryem tic ma myero gutim ki gwokogi. Gin ducu ma piny-ni nyuto Act onyo cik ma gin oa iye.
Carry your licence and registration docu: Bed ki laicen meri ki karatac me coyo nying pikipiki
Section 146(1) of the Traffic and Road S: Section 146(1) me Traffic and Road Safety Act, macalo kiloko i 2020, waco ni dano ma ryemo i yo myero bed ki kopi me laicen me ryemo ma tye atir kare ducu, dok onyut laicen ma kikome i cawa 72 ka lapulici ma oruko yunifom openye. Section 146(2) waco lok acel-li pi kopi me buk me coyo nying (logbook), ki ma kikome i cawa 120.
You do not have to carry the original li: Pe mitte ni ibed ki laicen ma kikome nino ducu, ento myero ibed ki kopi. Ka lapulici openyi, nyut laicen ma kikome i nino 3 (cawa 72) ki buk me coyo nying ma kikome i nino 5 (cawa 120).
Keep a clear copy or photo of your licen: Gwok kopi ma nen maber onyo cal me laicen meri ki buk me coyo nying pikipiki.
If asked for the original, take it to th: Ka kipenyi pi ma kikome, ter i sitecen me pulici i kare ma cik miyo.
Write down the officer’s name, station,: Coo nying lapulici, sitecen ne, ki section me cik ma tye i karatac mo keken ma kimiyi.
Your licence must match the motorcycle y: Laicen meri myero rwatte ki pikipiki ma iryemo
Section 35(1) of the Traffic and Road Sa: Section 35(1) me Traffic and Road Safety Act mito ni dano obed ki laicen ma tye atir pi kit motoka ma eryemo. Section 36 nyuto kit laicen, ki sections 70(1)(g) ki 94(1)(g) loko i kom laicen pi pikipiki ki pikipiki me tyen adek ma kitiyo kwede me nongo cente, kacel ki Class M.
A licence for one group of vehicles does: Laicen pi kit motoka acel pe kwako kit mukene. Ka itye ka tingo dano pi cente, ngi ni kit ma kicoyo i laicen meri kwako tic meno.
Ngi kit ma kicoyo i laicen meri.
Do not ride for hire if your licence doe: Pe iryem dano pi cente ka laicen meri pe kwako kit meno.
Ask the licensing office or a legal aid: Peny opic ma miyo laicen onyo dul me kony me cik ka pe ingeyo maber.
Wear a proper helmet, fastened: Ruk elemet ma atir, ma itweyo maber
Regulation 11 of the Traffic and Road Sa: Regulation 11 me Traffic and Road Safety (Motorcycles and Motorised Tricycles) Regulations, 2016 (S.I. 30 of 2016), macalo S.I. 34 of 2023 oloko, mito ni kiruk elemet ki kitwey maber. Loko me 2023 bene mito ni elemet orwatte ki cik pa Uganda National Bureau of Standards.
The helmet must be on your head and prop: Elemet myero bed i wii ki itwey maber, pe itingo keken. Myero rwatte ki rwom pa UNBS. Dano ma itingo bene mito elemet.
Twey elemet maber ma peya icako wot mo keken.
Use a helmet that meets the UNBS standar: Tii ki elemet ma rwatte ki rwom pa UNBS.
Peny dano ma itingo wek oruk elemet bene.
Traffic convictions can be recorded agai: Bal me yo romo kicoyo i laicen meri
Section 122A, inserted by the Traffic an: Section 122A, ma kimedo i Traffic and Road Safety Act (Amendment) Act 2020, miyo Minisita twero me yubo cik i kom yo me demerit points (alama me bal). Cik magi poko bal ma lube ki pekgi, ki coyo alama i laicen pa dano meno.
If you are convicted of some traffic off: Ka kot onongo ni itimo bal mogo me yo, alama romo kicoyo i laicen meri. Ter karatac mo keken ma kicoyo macalo lok madit, ci inong tam ma peya iye bal.
Ask for a written notice stating the exa: Peny karatac ma kicoyo ma nyuto bal kikome ki cik ma kiwaco.
Keep the notice and any official receipt: Gwok karatac ki risit mo keken me gamente maber.
Ask a legal aid provider what the notice: Peny dul me kony me cik tyen karatac ma peya iculo onyo iye bal.
The current Ugandan law on public and pr: Cik pa Uganda ma tye kombedi i kom cuk pa gamente ki pa dano, coyo nying lucat, miyo kabedo, cente me cuk ki pyem.
Amends the Traffic and Road Safety Act:: Loko Traffic and Road Safety Act: karatac me laicen, demerit points, bal ki cul.
Amends the 2016 motorcycle regulations,: Loko cik me pikipiki me 2016, kacel ki cik me elemet ki cik pa jo ma tingo dano.
KCCA rules for certain named street trad: Cik pa KCCA i kom tic mogo me cat i yo i Kampala.
Applies only to specific street trader a: Kwako tic mogo keken me lucat i yo i Kampala — pe kwako kabedo ducu i cuk.
The Markets Act, 2023 sets out how publi: Markets Act, 2023 nyuto kit ma myero kitel kwede cuk pa gamente. Magi aye bute ma mako lucat loyo.
Vendor registration must be free: Coyo nying lacat myero obed me nono
Section 18(4) of the Markets Act, 2023 p: Section 18(4) me Markets Act, 2023 waco ni kicoyo nying lacat me nono. Section 18(5) mito namba me coyo nying, ki section 18(8) mito ni kinyut rejista.
You should not be charged just to be reg: Pe myero kimiyi iculu cente pi coyo nyingi keken. Myero inong namba me coyo nying, ki rejista pa lucat myero kinyut wek iromo ngiyo nyingi.
Check that your name appears on the disp: Ngi ni nyingi tye i rejista ma kinyuto.
Keep your registration slip or card safe: Gwok karatac onyo kad me coyo nyingi maber.
Section 21 of the Markets Act, 2023 prov: Section 21 me Markets Act, 2023 keto kakiri me miyo kabedo me tic, duka, ki kabedo me cat i cuk pa gamente. Lucat ma kicoyo nyinggi con aye gibedo mukwongo. Lacat pe twero bedo ki kabedo makato acel, dok miyo kabedo bot dano mukene pi cente labongo twero pe kiye; dano ma timo meno labongo twero myero oa woko.
A committee, not just one official, deci: Kakiri, pe latic acel keken, aye moko nga ma binongo kabedo. Ka onongo kicoyo nyingi con i cuk meno, myero kinen boti mukwongo. Iromo bedo ki kabedo acel keken dok pe iromo miyo dano mukene pi cente labongo twero.
Keep your allocation slip and registrati: Gwok karatac me miyo kabedo ki karatac me coyo nyingi.
Ask who sits on the allocation committee: Peny nga ma gitye i kakiri me miyo kabedo.
Get written authorisation before sublett: Nong twero ma kicoyo ma peya imiyo kabedo bot dano mukene pi cente.
Written notice before layout changes: Karatac me ngec ma peya kiloko yub me cuk
Section 16(2) of the Markets Act, 2023 r: Section 16(2) me Markets Act, 2023 mito karatac me ngec me dwe adek onyo makato ma peya kiloko yub onyo cal pa cuk pa gamente.
If the market will be reorganised or reb: Ka kibiyubo cuk odoco onyo kibigero odoco, myero kimi lucat ngec ki coc dwe adek onyo makato ma peya. Waco ki dog keken pe romo.
Peny karatac me ngec ma kicoyo ci igwoki.
Ngi nino ma tye i karatac.
Raise your objections through the market: Tit gin ma pe iye kwede bot kakiri me cuk ma peya tic ocake.
Market fees must be set and displayed: Cente me cuk myero kiket ki kinyut
Section 24(1) and (2) of the Markets Act: Section 24(1) ki (2) me Markets Act, 2023 waco ni ludito me loc aye keto cente me cuk dok myero kinyut.
You should be able to see the official f: Myero iromo neno lista me cente me cuk pa gamente. Ka kipenyi iculu cente ma pe tye i lista meno, peny tito ki coc ki risit.
Peny me neno lista me cente ma kinyuto.
When a stall may be treated as abandoned: Kare ma kabedo romo kineno ni kiweko
Section 22 of the Markets Act, 2023 trea: Section 22 me Markets Act, 2023 neno kabedo ni kiweko ka pe tye dano iye pi dwe adek onyo lacat pe oculo cente me cuk pi dwe adek. Section 26(2) nio (5) waco ni kiromo mako jami ki cato i nino 14 lacen, cente ma odong kidwoko bot dano, ki kimiyo kabedo bot dano mukene.
If your stall is empty for three months,: Ka kabedo meri tye nono pi dwe adek, onyo pe iculo cente me cuk pi dwe adek, ludito romo neno ni iweko. Ka kimako jami, cik nyuto yo: cato i nino 14 lacen, dok cente ma odong ka doki kiculo wel ducu obedo meri.
Keep paying fees or agree a written paym: Mede ki culo cente onyo wuye i yub me culo ma kicoyo.
If you will be away, tell market managem: Ka ibibedo ka mukene, mi ludito cuk ngec ki coc.
If goods are seized, ask for a written i: Ka kimako jami, peny lista ma kicoyo ki gin ma bitime i kom cente ma odong.
Disputes are handled by elected departme: Ludito bute ma kiyero aye tyeko pyem
Section 19(3) and 19(5)(c) of the Market: Section 19(3) ki 19(5)(c) me Markets Act, 2023 keto ludito ma kiyero pi bute me cuk dok miyogi tic, kacel ki tyeko pyem.
If you disagree with market management o: Ka pe iye lok ki ludito cuk onyo lacat mukene, Act mito ni ludito bute ma kiyero aye gutyek pyem meno mukwongo.
Ask which department head handles your d: Peny latel bute mene ma tyeko pyem meri.
Put your complaint in writing and keep a: Coo peko meri ci igwok kopi.
If it is not resolved, contact a legal a: Ka pe otum, kube ki dul me kony me cik.
Section 32 of the Markets Act, 2023 proh: Section 32 me Markets Act, 2023 gengo cato woko ki i kabedo ma kimiyo ki i yo me wot onyo i kulo me pii.
Trade from the space allocated to you. D: Cat i kabedo ma kimiyi. Keto jami i yo me wot onyo gengo kulo me pii romo kelo ni ludito gutim gin mo i komi.
Ngi kama kabedo ma kimiyi tye iye.
Pe iket jami i yo me wot onyo i kulo me pii.
Ask market management to confirm your sp: Peny ludito cuk wek gumok kabedo meri ki coc.
The current Ugandan law on vendor regist: Cik pa Uganda ma tye kombedi i kom coyo nying lucat, miyo kabedo, cente me cuk, karatac me ngec ki pyem.
Relevant if a dispute involves a vehicle: Mako lok ka pyem kwako motoka onyo tero jami i cuk onyo ki i cuk.
